what: DWS maintained status — the human-knowledge layer (open threads, waiting-on-whom). The pages/sources map is auto-derived in dws_manifest.json; this file holds what a scanner can't know. Edit by hand when a thread opens/closes.
role_one_liner: design-SB is the RENDER layer: it owns the deploy repo (grammarofmeaning-site), renders every drawer/page from the other SBs' DATA exports, self-merges site PRs, and is read-only on twelve-laws.
conventions: Render-from-data, never hardcode (§2.16). A page fetches a mirrored DATA artifact; if it can't render from data yet, that's a flagged gap, not a licence to hardcode.
Mirror flow: owner-SB exports DATA on twelve-laws main → design-SB `git show origin/main:… > engine/data/X.json` → page fetches it → deploy (self-merged site PR).

schema.html is the flagship (PI author-watches it): change it only via fail-safe monkey-patches in an isolated <script> block — main script byte-identical, typeof-guards + try/catch → fall back to the prior render. Never edit the 175KB const P blob by hand.

Offline validation (no pane needed for static pages): regex-aware JS balance scan + replay the render logic against the real data in Python + curl the deployed file. Confirm zero bracket-delta vs known-good HEAD.
Pane-gated = scroll/drag/step interaction that only exists live; can't be verified offline. Build those with a live browser (mine, or the PI as eyes).
